text:
olivia: quick heads-up — I ran `pnpm audit --json` against console-ui and found a couple of transitive vuln hits that we should triage before the next release. want to agree an approach that minimizes lockfile churn.

ben: can you paste the audit summary? are these something `pnpm update` will fix or do we need overrides/resolutions?

olivia: snippet from the run:
```
# pnpm audit (summary)
high: 1 — ssri (< 8.0.1) via webpack > ssri
moderate: 2 — minimist, debug via build tooling/transitive deps
recommendation: upgrade webpack to >=5.88.0 or apply targeted overrides
```

priya: +1 on keeping lockfile changes minimal. bumping webpack will cascade. alternative is to add pnpm overrides for `ssri` and `minimist` and do a `--lockfile-only` update, then create a tiny PR.

alex: note pnpm override syntax in package.json works well: e.g.
```
"pnpm": { "overrides": { "ssri": "8.0.1", "minimist": "1.2.7" } }
```
That updates the lockfile deterministically without forcing webpack bumps.

ben: is locking ssri safe for runtime? webpack pulls it in for parsing integrity in some loaders — should be OK but we should smoke test builds and devserver.

dependabot: Automated security PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/2314 — upgrades webpack -> 5.88.0 (candidate fix). CI: failing stylelint, so not green.

olivia: proposal: short-term patch = pnpm overrides + lockfile-only PR. mid-term = accept the dependabot webpack bump in a separate, tested PR with visual regression tests. Steps:
1) add pnpm overrides for ssri and minimist
2) run `pnpm install --lockfile-only`
3) run `pnpm audit` + `pnpm build` smoke
4) open a small PR with changelog note and ask eng-runtime for review

priya: I can do 1-3 today. will also add an entry to the release notes and INFSEC ticket.

alex: also add a short comment in the PR explaining why we used overrides (minimize churn) and link to the dependabot PR for the proper dependency bump.

ben: tiny ask — let's run browserslist/caniuse checks after build to ensure no bundling differences.

olivia: agreed. I'll tag @eng-runtime and @sre in the PR reviewers.

priya: creating branch now: `git checkout -b fix/console/overrides-ssri-minimist` — will push in ~10m and open PR.

security-bot: CVE reference: CVE-2023-XXXXX (ssri) — CVSS: 7.5 (high). Flagged as exploitable in build toolchains. Scheduling follow-up scan in 24h.

ben: adding INFSEC-4567 to the PR description and tagging infra owners.

olivia: perfect. once PR merges we should run the full e2e pipeline and monitor for any runtime regressions. thanks all. :thumbsup
